setting: Sentence-level lip reading / VSR / AVSR (the 633-study population of M06/sentence-lipreading-sequence-objective, SENT regex over ledger text) for usual approach and behind decisions; novelty precedents counted over the whole wiki in any modality (full-text recall check, dated before 2020-06).

inherited.M01: Overt speech video (VoxCeleb2, LRS2, LRS3) with paired audio
inherited.M03: Pretraining on ASR-labelled VoxCeleb2 clean subset (two ASR-based filters), then optional ground-truth fine-tuning; NovoGrad; no seeds or repeated runs
inherited.M05: Face/mouth video through a public word-level lip-reading front end (spatio-temporal ResNet)
inherited.M06: Jasper-lip 5x3 1D convolutional CTC student on visual features (Jasper ASR lineage)
inherited.M08: English character sequence (graphemes plus CTC blank)
inherited.M11: Original LRS2/LRS3 transcripts and test splits; no speaker-overlap statement
inherited.M13: Public data; four 11 GB GPUs; no latency or device figures

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule (lip reading / VSR / AVSR studies classified by label source for unlabelled video). For this review the counts are restricted to the 633-study sentence-level population and to first-public date: prior before 2019-05, [concurrent] 2019-05 to 2020-05. Boundary: forced-alignment, perception, synthesis and enhancement papers excluded on reading the snippet; versions once.

design_regex.asr_labels: ASR/recogniser-generated transcripts or labels, automatic transcripts, pseudo-labels

topics.metric: LRS3 / LRS2 visual-only WER, lower better

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule (any non-acoustic or audio-visual speech decoding with a teacher-student objective). For this review: whole-wiki full-text recall over studies dated before 2020-06 for a distillation term co-occurring with a non-acoustic signal term, snippets read; hits classified as same design (audio/ASR teacher into a non-acoustic student), other distillation, mention or reference, off-population.

Published rule (visual-only WER on LRS3 test). For this review: target-time counts (prior before 2019-05, [concurrent] 2019-05 to 2020-05) of run-to-run spread reporting (seeds, repeated runs, standard deviation, intervals), hits read.
